name: alt_missing
title: Missing alternative text
summary: Image alternative text is not present.

name: alt_link_missing
title: Linked image missing alternative text
summary: An image without alternative text results in an empty link.

name: alt_spacer_missing
title: Spacer image missing alternative text
summary: A layout spacer image (which should have null/empty alternative text) does not have an alt attribute.

name: alt_input_missing
title: Image button missing alternative text
summary: Alternative text is not present for a form image button.

name: alt_area_missing
title: Image map area missing alternative text
summary: Alternative text is not present for an image map area (hot spot).

name: alt_map_missing
title: Image map missing alternative text
summary: An image that has hot spots does not have an alt attribute.

name: longdesc_invalid
title: Invalid longdesc
summary: The longdesc attribute is not a URL.

name: label_missing
title: Missing form label
summary: A form control does not have a corresponding label.

name: label_empty
title: Empty form label
summary: A form label is present, but does not contain any content.

name: label_multiple
title: Multiple form labels
summary: A form control has more than one label associated with it.

name: aria_reference_broken
title: Broken ARIA reference
summary: An aria-labelledby or aria-describedby reference exists, but the target for the reference does not exist.

name: aria_menu_broken
title: Broken ARIA menu
summary: An ARIA menu does not contain required menu items.

name: title_invalid
title: Missing or uninformative page title
summary: The page title is missing or not descriptive.

name: language_missing
title: Language missing or invalid
summary: The language of the document is not identified or a lang attribute value is invalid.

name: meta_refresh
title: Page refreshes or redirects
summary: The page is set to automatically change location or refresh using a <meta> tag.

name: heading_empty
title: Empty heading
summary: A heading contains no content.

name: button_empty
title: Empty button
summary: A button is empty or has no value text.

name: link_empty
title: Empty link
summary: A link contains no text.

name: link_skip_broken
title: Broken skip link
summary: A skip navigation link exists, but the target for the link does not exist or the link is not keyboard accessible.

name: th_empty
title: Empty table header
summary: A <th> (table header) contains no text.

name: blink
title: Blinking content
summary: Blinking content is present.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
summary: A <marquee> element is present.

name: contrast
title: Very low contrast
summary: Very low contrast between text and background colors.

name: alt_suspicious
title: Suspicious alternative text
summary: Alternative text is likely insufficient or contains extraneous information.

name: alt_redundant
title: Redundant alternative text
summary: The alternative text for an image is the same as nearby or adjacent text.

name: alt_duplicate
title: A nearby image has the same alternative text
summary: Two images near each other have the same alternative text.

name: alt_long
title: Long alternative text
summary: An image has very long alternative text.

name: longdesc
title: Long description
summary: The longdesc attribute is present.

name: image_title
title: Image with title
summary: An image has a title attribute value but no alt value.

name: label_orphaned
title: Orphaned form label
summary: A form label is present, but it is not correctly associated with a form control.

name: label_title
title: Unlabeled form control with title
summary: A form control does not have a label, but has a title.

name: select_missing_label
title: Select missing label
summary: A select element does not have an associated label

name: fieldset_missing
title: Missing fieldset
summary: A group of check boxes or radio buttons is not enclosed in a fieldset.

name: legend_missing
title: Fieldset missing legend
summary: A fieldset does not have a legend.

name: heading_missing
title: No heading structure
summary: The page has no headings.

name: h1_missing
title: Missing first level heading
summary: A page does not have a first level heading.

name: region_missing
title: No page regions
summary: No page regions or ARIA landmarks were found.

name: heading_skipped
title: Skipped heading level
summary: A heading level is skipped.

name: heading_possible
title: Possible heading
summary: Text appears to be a heading but is not a heading element.

name: table_layout
title: Layout table
summary: A layout table is present.

name: table_caption_possible
title: Possible table caption
summary: Text appears to be a table caption, but is not a caption element.

name: list_possible
title: Possible list
summary: Text is structured like a list but lacks proper list semantics.

name: link_internal_broken
title: Broken same-page link
summary: A link to another location within the page is present but does not have a corresponding target.

name: link_suspicious
title: Suspicious link text
summary: Link text contains extraneous text or may not make sense out of context.

name: link_redundant
title: Redundant link
summary: Adjacent links go to the same URL.

name: link_word
title: Link to Word document
summary: A link to a Microsoft Word document is present.

name: link_excel
title: Link to Excel spreadsheet
summary: A link to a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet is present.

name: link_powerpoint

summary: A link to a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation is present.

name: link_pdf

summary: A link to a PDF document is present.

name: link_document
title: Link to document
summary: A link to a non-HTML document is present.

name: audio_video

summary: An audio or video file or link is present.

guidelines.name: 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) (Level A)

guidelines.name: 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) (Level A)

name: underline

summary: Alternative text is null or empty (alt="").

name: alt_spacer

summary: Alternative text is null or empty (alt="") on a spacer image.

summary: Alternative text is present for an image that is within a link.

name: alt_input

summary: Alternative text is present for an image input element.

name: alt_map

name: alt_area

summary: Alternative text is present for an image map area (hot spot).

name: figure

name: label

summary: A form label is present and associated with a form control.

summary: A fieldset is present.

name: link_skip

name: link_skip_target

summary: A target for a "skip" link is present.

summary: An unordered (bulleted) list (<ul> element) is present.

summary: A definition/description list (<dl> element) is present.

summary: A <header> element or banner landmark is present.

name: nav

summary: A <nav> element or navigation landmark is present.

name: search

summary: An ARIA search landmark is present.

summary: A <main> element or main landmark is present.

name: aside
title: Aside
summary: An <aside> element or complementary landmark is present.

name: footer

summary: A <footer> element or contentinfo landmark is present.

summary: An ARIA region is present

summary: A data table is present.

summary: A table caption is present.

summary: A table header cell (<th>) is present.

name: th_row

summary: A table row header (<th scope="row">) is present.

name: iframe
title: Inline frame
summary: An inline frame (<iframe>) is present.

name: aria
title: ARIA
summary: An ARIA role, state, or property is present.

name: aria_label
title: ARIA label
summary: An aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute is present.

name: aria_describedby
title: ARIA description
summary: An aria-describedby attribute is present.

name: aria_live_region
title: ARIA alert or live region
summary: An ARIA alert role or live region is present.

name: aria_menu
title: ARIA menu
summary: An ARIA menu is present.

name: aria_button
title: ARIA button
summary: An element with role="button" is present.

name: aria_expanded
title: ARIA expanded
summary: An aria-expanded attribute is present.

name: aria_haspopup
title: ARIA popup
summary: An element triggers a popup menu, dialog, or other element.

name: aria_tabindex
title: ARIA tabindex
summary: A tabindex value of 0 or less is present.

name: aria_hidden
title: ARIA hidden
summary: Content is hidden with ARIA.

name: viewport_zoom_blocked
title: Zoom blocked by viewport meta
summary: The viewport meta tag disables zoom (user-scalable=no) or caps it below 200% (maximum-scale).

name: media_autoplay
title: Media autoplays
summary: A <video> or <audio> element has the autoplay attribute. Audio that plays automatically for more than 3 seconds needs a way to pause or mute it.

name: h1_multiple
title: Multiple H1 headings
summary: The page has more than one <h1>. A single H1 that names the page is the checklist expectation.

name: iframe_title_missing
title: Missing iframe title
summary: An <iframe> has no title or accessible name.

name: focus_outline_removed
title: Focus outline removed
summary: CSS removes the focus outline and sets no other visible focus style (box-shadow, border, background). Confirm focus is still visible.

name: dialog_name_missing
title: Dialog without a name
summary: A dialog (<dialog> or role=dialog/alertdialog) has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.

name: video_captions_missing
title: Video without captions track
summary: A <video> has no <track kind="captions">. Captions may be burned into the video or supplied by a player; confirm.

name: id_duplicate
title: Duplicate id
summary: The same id is used on more than one element in a file. Broken label and ARIA references follow from this.

name: aria_role_invalid
title: Invalid ARIA role
summary: The role attribute holds a value that is not a valid ARIA role.

name: aria_attr_invalid
title: Invalid ARIA attribute
summary: An attribute starting with aria- is not a defined ARIA attribute (often a typo).

name: aria_required_attr
title: Required ARIA attribute missing
summary: An element with an ARIA role lacks an attribute that role requires (for example aria-checked on role=checkbox).

name: aria_name_missing
title: ARIA control without a name
summary: An element with an ARIA role such as button, tab, checkbox or textbox has no accessible name.

name: aria_hidden_focusable
title: Focusable content inside aria-hidden
summary: An element with aria-hidden="true" contains something that can still receive keyboard focus.

name: nested_interactive
title: Nested interactive controls
summary: A link or button is placed inside another link or button, so screen readers may not announce it.

name: input_button_name_missing
title: Input button without a name
summary: An <input type="button"> has no value, aria-label or title.

name: role_img_alt_missing
title: role=img without a name
summary: An element with role="img" (including an svg) has no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.

name: label_in_name_mismatch
title: Visible text not in accessible name
summary: The aria-label of a link or button does not contain its visible text, which breaks voice control.

name: scope_attr_invalid
title: Invalid scope attribute
summary: scope on a table cell is not col, row, colgroup or rowgroup, or is used on a td.

name: main_missing
title: No main landmark
summary: The page has no <main> or role="main".

name: main_multiple
title: More than one main landmark
summary: The page has more than one <main> or role="main".

name: inline_spacing_important
title: Text spacing locked with !important
summary: An inline style sets letter-, word- or line-spacing with !important, which stops users applying their own text spacing.

name: target_size_small
title: Small target size
summary: An interactive element declares a width or height under 24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 target size).

name: focus_obscured_risk
title: Fixed or sticky element may cover focus
summary: A fixed or sticky header, footer or panel can hide the element that has keyboard focus.

name: auth_autocomplete_off
title: Password field blocks autofill
summary: autocomplete=off on a password field stops password managers, which makes sign-in a memory test.

name: auth_paste_blocked
title: Paste handler on an input
summary: An input has an onPaste handler; pasting into login fields must not be blocked.

name: captcha_present
title: CAPTCHA present
summary: A CAPTCHA is present; it needs a non-cognitive alternative and a text alternative.

name: dragging_alternative
title: Drag interaction
summary: Drag and drop is used; a single-pointer or keyboard alternative must exist.

name: autocomplete_missing
title: Personal-data field without autocomplete
summary: A field that collects personal data has no autocomplete token.

name: text_spacing_clipped
title: Fixed height clips text
summary: A container with a fixed height and overflow hidden can cut off text when users change text spacing.

name: hover_without_focus
title: Hover-only content
summary: Content appears on mouse hover with no keyboard focus equivalent.

guidelines.name: 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus (Level AA)

name: orientation_locked
title: Orientation locked in CSS
summary: CSS hides or rotates content for one device orientation.

name: autoplay_carousel
title: Auto-advancing carousel
summary: A carousel or slider auto-plays; it needs a pause, stop or hide control.

name: reduced_motion_missing
title: Animation without reduced-motion support
summary: CSS animations exist but no prefers-reduced-motion rule is present in the scanned CSS.

name: click_no_keyboard
title: Click handler without keyboard access
summary: A non-interactive element (div, span, li...) has an onClick handler but cannot be focused or operated with the keyboard.

name: icon_button_name_missing
title: Icon button without a name
summary: An IconButton, Fab or ToggleButton holds only an icon and has no aria-label.

name: status_role_missing
title: Status message without live region
summary: A toast, snackbar or notification container has no role=status, role=alert or aria-live, so screen readers may not announce it.

name: datagrid_review
title: Data grid to review
summary: A data grid component is used; keyboard navigation, headers and names must be tested in the browser.
